insider.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. No multiplayer, no DLC and one playthrough is enough. The long pole is A Long Road, the 100% completion checklist, and almost everything else feeds into it, so follow the roadmap stages in order and this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1. There is nothing to plan for — just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins. Keep playing the story and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3 begins. Nothing to do but play through the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when Chapter 3 ends — PowerPyx says it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Just keep playing.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when Chapter 4 ends, after its final mission, Starting From Zero. Play the chapter to its end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when you finish the final mission and the story closes. PowerPyx records it unlocking with the story's last mission, so finishing the game is all it takes.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one: reach 100% on the completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which opens after the story. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx stresses it is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles only partly (scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals), and only 70 of 80 challenges are needed. The only tasks that need everything are Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests. Budget about 100 hours after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the game's 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories however you like — PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridge flights the quickest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see what you have done. Most come up on their own in the story; filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) for the rest.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges. PowerPyx's range guide lists every location. The golds are not hard, and the ranges also level your Focus, which helps the Gunslinger trophy later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total. Winning once per location is enough; you do not need to win every race. The races are short, so work through the locations as you travel.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so any 20 count. Races also feed the activity tracker, so this overlaps with Master of None — do them together.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map — follow his fishing questline. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types, so it helps Master of None too.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Four Video Games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home (from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not all its challenges — pick whichever you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It marks automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls Lucia, then texts her address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. All of them are still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It marks in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls and gets a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — use the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring the finds back to him. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3; PowerPyx notes that calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up. Track him under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It marks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. All of them are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. All of them can still be found after the story in free-roam; check the trophy tracker for your count. More qualifying strands are still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List. It marks after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); he marks some on the map, and you can steal others off the street — scan a car with WAiNK to check if it is on the list. Deliver in good condition for more money. Track it under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is only available as Jason. It marks after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty; purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This. All of it is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2 (track under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations). This is the one possibly missable trophy: PowerPyx flags a Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to show you how to meditate. It is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it counts toward the trophy — do it anyway to be safe. You cannot finish the last meditation until both characters can play together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline, exclusive to Jason, marks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County. His first quest gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrieve it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker); hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks the trophy, and the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks, so this should come naturally.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets — PowerPyx's card guide lists all 18 set locations. You do not need all 18; three sets is enough, so pick the sets whose cards you find first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with WAiNK (hold Up and R1). There are far more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any 100 count, so scan as you travel instead of hunting them down one by one.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges (track under Progress, Challenges). The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — PowerPyx advises leaving it for late and picking the easiest remaining challenges, since many complete naturally while you work on other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can free-roam together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Cause carnage to reach 4 stars, then escape: PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses you. The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone. It also comes naturally during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… and the bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level — an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline help. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3): loot a couple of items per store, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and if it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly) and scan vehicles with R1 — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; you only need to scan, not drive. There are 557 vehicles at launch. The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model scans, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar). Buff focus first with food or drinks or a shower at home, take Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — line up gang members at an illegal gang operation. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Focus); it levels through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes on the airfield. PowerPyx's easiest: the plane at terminals E3/E4 — drive through a fence onto the airfield, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip, take off and fly at least 1 km away. The unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx: they are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate, or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies (green map icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it — that triggers the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to hand off a cash bag. After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 (after his Payday Loans quests). Vaults give 4 stars instantly — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles. The 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way; a vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…) — robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, sticky-bomb its back door, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. You need all 8 large bank jobs for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map, all 52 areas. PowerPyx's fastest method: fly a plane over every fogged patch until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations (yellow map icons when you are near them); one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39. Track per gang under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. As of 20 Nov 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as unsolved — no confirmed method yet. The description points to a bar or venue on Ocean Beach; check back as guides update. This guide flags it honestly rather than inventing a method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. As of 20 Nov 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as unsolved — no confirmed method yet. The description suggests driving a car out through a showroom's glass front; this guide flags it honestly rather than inventing a method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation). Go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling if you can: the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 (north-east corner table) and the office safe (north-east hallway — bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on pickup, and you do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so you can return for anything missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength, heart icon). Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can switch characters. Work out together — buy a gym membership, and always bring your partner (Right + Triangle); while one trains, the other progresses too. Gyms are all over Vice City (filter Map, Activities); you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On) and watch for the demon-face icon after your actions. PowerPyx: stealthy objectives and clean escapes build Professional, limb shots build Hardened, killing builds Violent, mass killing builds Psycho — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going that far. It accrues passively through robberies and fights; if you are short at the end, it can be farmed quickly.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. As of 20 Nov 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as unsolved, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No confirmed method yet — this guide flags it honestly rather than inventing one.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? As of 20 Nov 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as unsolved, believed to be from a UFO questline. No confirmed method yet — this guide flags it honestly rather than inventing one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. As of 20 Nov 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as unsolved, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. No confirmed method yet — this guide flags it honestly rather than inventing one.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative, not in one trip, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so it comes naturally with the robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they are the fastest way through it. It counts across every shop type — Ammu-Nation, mod shops, clothing, tattoo studios and more.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total). They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone; buy through it. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quick way to fund them. Four more garages come from the story and do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), which also unlocks Moses in Port Gellhorn. You need garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses, choose Respray then Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
